summary.headline: Keystone Realtors Q1 FY27 revenue rose 72% YoY to INR 470 crores, with EBITDA margin at 21.3% and PAT of INR 52.4 crores, its highest-ever Q1 PAT.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 pre-sales were INR 617 crores with no new launches, and collections rose 4% YoY to INR 599 crores at 97% collection efficiency. Revenue, EBITDA and PAT all grew sharply, helped by the shift to percentage-of-completion recognition and a richer product mix. Two projects were added (Igatpuri plotted development of about 62 acres and a Dindoshi cluster addition, together about INR 547 crores GDV), and the company reiterated its launch pipeline of about INR 8,000 crores-plus GDV for the year. Operating cash flow was INR 68 crores, which management said will pick up from Q2 and more visibly in Q3 and Q4, while the INR 1,000 crore OCF guidance was reaffirmed.

segments.name: Mass market (Virar JDAs)
segments.commentary: Virar FSI given out via JDAs; about 60% margin net of approval costs, with the unsold portion of about INR 181 crores (32% of INR 570 crores unsold revenue) expected to drive the higher embedded margin of the mass segment (~30% EBITDA margin on unsold). Sold share so far is only about 8%.

segments.name: Luxury / super premium
segments.commentary: Five luxury projects (Panorama, Ocean Vista, Cliff Tower, Bandstand, Parishram-completed) with unsold inventory in four; about INR 12 billion of unrecognised luxury revenue cited. Management is tilting the future pipeline toward premium and super premium.

guidance_outlook: Pre-sales guidance of INR 10,000 crores in FY30 referenced; analyst's implied run-rate for remaining three quarters is INR 4,300-4,400 crores.

Launch pipeline for FY27 of about INR 8,000 crores-plus GDV: Urban Woods (2 towers, INR 300-plus crores), Avinash Towers (Versova), Urbania Thane (2 towers), GTB Nagar Phase 1, Dindoshi cluster, Om Nagar (Andheri East); 28 HQ and Ozone Skye already launched (about INR 2,000-plus crores).
OCF guidance of INR 1,000 crores for FY27 reaffirmed; OCF to pick up from Q2, more visible in Q3 and Q4.
Gross D/E guidance raised to 0.75:1 earlier this year; current 0.3:1. Management does not intend to remain net cash over time.
Unrecognised sold revenue to be recognised over about 2 to 2.5 years on average (up to 3 years for early-stage projects).
Legacy completed-project-method revenue expected to be about 15% of FY27 revenue; about 95% of the legacy portion to be recognised in FY27. From FY28 about 98% of revenue to be on POC.
Plotted development target: INR 500-750 crores annual pre-sales and INR 150-200 crores margin per year, as stated minimum expectation.
capex_capacity: Land and approval investment of INR 232 crores in Q1 FY27 vs INR 151 crores in Q1 FY26, indicating more launches ahead.
About 12 million sq ft under development across 17 ongoing projects.
Igatpuri plotted development of about 62 acres added; plotted projects to be launched only at about 70% readiness.
GTB Nagar (MHADA C&DA): HPC cleared, final signatures pending; launch expected in Q1 or early Q2 FY28 per management. Dindoshi (MHADA): next HPC hearing, then about 2.5-3 months to launch.
Ozone Skye (Goregaon West): RERA approved, work started in July 2026, ready for launch. 28 HQ (Prabhadevi, commercial): construction commenced July 2026.
Investment before go-live targeted at about 10% of GDV under asset-light model; target gross margin around 35%.
demand_pricing: Management says luxury and premium demand is at equivalent levels; mid-mass and aspirational walk-ins are strong depending on location, with Thane and Dombivli performing to plan.
Pre-sales of INR 617 crores achieved without launches, described as resilient sustained sales on a high base.
Bank-backed 10:90 payment plans offered for about 85% of schemes; no more than 30% of buyers opt for them, per management.
Management says interest-rate sensitivity is limited for luxury buyers; the sub-INR 1 crore segment is more rate-sensitive and its share in the pipeline is falling.
Current-year revenue mix: about 40% from completed-project method projects and 60% from POC projects. Gross margin on current projects about 35% and PBT about 20%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the net debt outlook for FY27 and FY28, given the company now reports net debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said gross D/E guidance was raised to 0.75:1 and is at 0.3:1, net debt will likely turn positive over time, and the company does not intend to stay net cash; more than INR 800 crores of cash is held.

qa_highlights.question: Is OCF guidance of INR 1,000 crores intact, and when does OCF pick up?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, INR 1,000 crores guidance remains intact; OCF should begin improving from Q2, with a more noticeable difference in Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the mass-market embedded EBITDA margin near 30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly product mix: the Virar JDA revenue share carries about 60% margin, and about INR 181 crores of unsold revenue from these JDAs is yet to be recognised, versus only 8% sold so far.

qa_highlights.question: How quickly will the INR 63 billion of sold but unrecognised revenue be recognised?
qa_highlights.answer: Average of about 2 to 2.5 years; early-stage projects up to 3 years, late-stage 1 to 2 years.

qa_highlights.question: How big will plotted development be in FY30 presales?
qa_highlights.answer: Expected at INR 500-750 crores of annual pre-sales and INR 150-200 crores of margin per year as a minimum.

qa_highlights.question: Will the GTB and Dindoshi launches slip beyond FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects GTB this quarter or early next quarter and Dindoshi in this financial year, with maybe one quarter's slippage at most.

financial_highlights.change: from INR 238 crores in Q1 FY26

risks_watch: OCF: Q1 FY27 OCF was only INR 68 crores against the INR 1,000 crore FY27 guidance; management says pickup from Q2 and more visible in Q3 and Q4, so the back-loaded ramp needs to be tracked.

Launch timing: GTB Nagar (MHADA C&DA, final signatures pending) and Dindoshi (awaiting next HPC hearing, then about 2.5-3 months) must launch this FY; management said at most about one quarter of slippage.

Net debt turning positive: management said it does not intend to remain net cash and gross D/E guidance was raised to 0.75:1 versus 0.3:1 now, so balance sheet deployment and leverage trajectory need monitoring.

Legacy revenue roll-off: about 15% of FY27 revenue from completed-project method, with about 95% of that legacy portion recognised in FY27; the margin uplift depends on the POC projects delivering 35% gross margin.

Pre-sales run-rate: Q1 pre-sales of INR 617 crores came with no launches; the implied run-rate for the remaining three quarters to reach the guidance is about INR 4,300-4,400 crores, which depends on the FY27 launch slate.
Mass-market embedded margin: the ~30% EBITDA margin on unsold mass inventory rests on Virar JDA revenue (about 60% margin, only 8% sold so far), so its realisation is a key watch item.
key_quotes: For sure, that it will start picking up from the Q2. But more noticeable difference, you will be able to see in Q3 and Q4.
INR 1,000 crores guidance remains intact, yes.
So fundamentally, our intention is not to continue into the net cash position.
Very clearly, there has been actually equivalent amount of demand in the luxury and premium segments.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on collections, margins, credit ratings and the launch pipeline, and reiterated the INR 1,000 crore OCF guidance. It was more cautious on timing, deferring OCF improvement to Q2-Q4 and hedging on launch dates, and it was reticent on the luxury-demand question, saying only that luxury and premium demand were at equivalent levels.

growth.why: Revenue rose 72% YoY to INR 470 crore and FY27 launch pipeline of about INR 8,000 crore-plus GDV plus INR 232 crore land/approval spend (up 54%) support growth, but no company-stated FY27 revenue growth % and OCF is lagging (INR 68 crore vs INR 1,000 crore guide), so outlook is moderately positive rather than strong.
